svg.title: Fraud Shield — module wiring map
svg.desc: Every Python file in the Fraud Shield project shown as a node, with solid arrows for runtime imports and calls, and dashed arrows for data read/write paths.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does app.py do at startup — blueprint registration, state loading, atexit hook?')
sendPrompt('What does auth.py do and how does it render the Jinja template with session state?')
sendPrompt('How does prediction.py call monitor_transaction and build the CSV batch response?')
sendPrompt('How does dashboard.py compute stats from the in-memory TRANSACTIONS and ALERTS lists?')
sendPrompt('How does alerts.py handle acknowledge and verify endpoints and update the store?')
sendPrompt('How does the require_auth decorator check session state and return 401 for unauthenticated requests?')
sendPrompt('Break down every line of monitor_transaction() in scoring_service.py')
sendPrompt('What are all the behavior signals, how are behavior_points accumulated, and what triggers each signal?')
sendPrompt('Walk me through engineer_single_transaction — what does each of the 15 features represent?')
sendPrompt('When exactly does create_alert_if_needed fire an alert and what does the alert record look like?')
sendPrompt('List every environment variable config.py reads and what happens if they are unset')
sendPrompt('How does scoring_service load fraud_model.pkl and call predict_proba?')
sendPrompt('How does the StandardScaler transform inference features and why does order matter?')
sendPrompt('How does storage.py serialize sets to JSON and deserialize them back on load?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in instance/data_store.json and what is the legacy root-level data_store.json?')
sendPrompt('What metrics and threshold values are stored in model_metadata.json?')
sendPrompt('What is creditcard_raw.csv and how many rows and fraud transactions does it contain?')
sendPrompt('Step through train_model.py: data load, feature engineering, chrono split, RF training, threshold tuning, and artifact save')
sendPrompt('How does synthetic_data.py make fraud patterns probabilistic rather than deterministic?')
sendPrompt('What exactly does smoke_test.py check and how do I interpret a failure?')
sendPrompt('How does self.ipynb relate to train_model.py — does it share the same functions?')
